record.question: What is gift? On occasion such as weddings, funeral or religious functions, a govt.servant may accept gifts from his personal friends having no official dealings with him. However, he should make a report to the Govt. if the value of such gifts exceed (a) __________ in the case of Group 'A' Official (b) __________ in the case of Group 'B' Official (c) __________ in the case of Group 'C' Official (d) __________ in the case of Group 'D' Official. In any other case, a govt.servant shall not accept any gift without the sanction of the govt. if the value exceeds – (e) __________ in the case of Group 'A' & 'B' Official (f) __________ in the case of Group 'C' & 'D' Official
